Lifetime Guarantee View Details > Product Description Getting up from a low sofa or deep recliner quietly gets harder over time and that's exactly the problem the Vive Health stand assist solves. Two foam-padded handrails give you something solid to push off from, taking the strain off weak knees and unsteady legs without drilling into walls or making permanent changes to your furniture. The lightweight aluminum frame supports up to 300 lbs and locks into place under or around seat cushions in minutes. The open frame design works as a couch stand up assist on sofas, loveseats and recliners alike, fitting under removable cushions or wrapping around fixed ones. Width adjusts from 19.25" to 22.25" and depth from 24" to 27", covering most upholstered seating. The push-button handle height adjusts from 9" to 12", making this a well-fitted stand assist for recliner users who need a specific grip position. For broader seating upgrades, our Lift Chairs collection is worth a look. No tools, no installation, just slide it into place and it's ready. At under 3 lbs, this stand assist for elderly users is easy to move between rooms and simple to adjust day to day. It comes backed by a lifetime guarantee. For more daily living support options, our Stand Assists collection covers additional styles. Features SELF TRANSFER ASSIST Independently rise from the sofa, loveseat or recliner with the stable support of the stand assist FITS ANY UPHOLSTERED SEAT Versatile open design fits under any removable seat cushion and wraps around fixed cushions on upholstered chairs, recliners, sofas and loveseats FULLY ADJUSTABLE FRAME Easily adjust the length and width of the durable aluminum frame for greater stability in any seat PUSH BUTTON HEIGHT ADJUSTMENTS Raise and lower the hand grips with easy push-button adjustments DUAL HAND GRIPS Each armrest-style handle is covered with soft foam material for greater comfort EASY TOOL-FREE ASSEMBLY Simple to assemble, adjust and install without the use of any tools Customer Reviews Based on 23 reviews Write a review Will this work on wide arm recliners? Yes! The stabilizing bar easily adjusts to securely fit around most recliner seats. How wide is the space between the armrests? The width of the stand assist is easily adjustable from 19.25” to 22.25”. How far does the frame extend? The frame adjusts to a depth of 24” to 27” to secure around most seat cushions. How do I assemble the stand assist? Can I use the stand assist on top of a cushion? The Vive stand assist can be used when placed on top of a seat cushion, however, care must be taken to ensure the entire frame rests on the cushion to prevent the stand assist from sliding forward. Will this stand assist fit on a lift chair? Yes! The stand assist frame is adjustable to fit most upholstered seats including lift chairs. What is the maximum weight it will support? The Vive stand assist frame is designed to support up to 300 pounds. The stand assist device is for balance and support only and is not intended to be fully weight bearing. Does it matter how heavy the chair is? No, because the stand assist is for balance and support only by pushing down on the handles as you rise should not be affected by the weight of the chair. Could this be used under a mattress to help me get out of bed? The stand assist is designed for balance and support only with arm rails that curve backward, making it impractical for use under a mattress. For bedside assistance, please look at the Vive bedrail found here or the Vive bed ladder found here. Can I adjust the height of the handrails? Yes! The handrails are easily adjusted with a push button system between 9” to 12” in height. Will this work with my couch that does not have separate cushions? Yes, the stand assist can be used on top of a seat cushion, however, care must be taken to ensure the entire frame rests on the cushion to prevent the stand assist from sliding forward. Is this good for people with disablities / handicapped people? Yes, this product is specifically designed for individuals who require ongoing assistance with daily mobility, such as standing up. Built with long-term durability in mind, the transport stand assist supports those who will continue to need reliable aid for years to come. Uses: For aiding in rising from a seated position on a couch, recliner or similar upholstered chair Dimensions: Width: 19.25”- 22.25” Handle height: 9”- 12” Depth: 24”-27” Materials: Lightweight aluminum Foam padding How to Install: Adjust the depth of the stabilizing bar to the depth of the cushion, ensuring the arm of the stand assist will be supported and not hanging over the edge of the cushion Place the stabilizing bar under a loose cushion or around a secured cushion Warning: Never place the stand assist where part of the structure is hanging over the edge of the sofa or chair. Doing so increases the likelihood the stand assist could slip forward during use Care Instructions: Wipe down with a damp cloth or disinfectant wipe Dry immediately with a lint-free cloth What’s Included: Vive Stand Assist Lifetime guarantee UPC: 818323025439 Product Number: SUP1090 Shipping Weight: 2.8 pounds User Manual: Stand Assist User Manual

description.html: Lifetime Guarantee View Details > Features PROVIDES TOILET SAFETY Designed to prevent slip and falls when getting on or off a toilet STURDY SUPPORT Durable aluminum frame doesn’t wobble and holds up to 300 pounds UNIVERSAL SIZING Fits around most standard or elongated toilets or at a sink or vanity FREESTANDING DESIGN No need to attach to the floor or wall, making it easy to remove NO TOOLS NEEDED The corrosion-resistant frame snaps together easily and installs in seconds COMFORTABLE GRIP Padded foam handrails are easy to grasp and extra secure Customer Reviews Based on 23 reviews Write a review Who is the stand alone toilet safety rail recommended for? The safety rail is perfect for anyone who has limited mobility or is recovering from surgery or injury. This includes those who are elderly or disabled. What are the dimensions of the stand alone toilet safety rail? The safety rail is 26.5” long, 19” deep and 25.5” high. How wide is the space between the handrails? There is 21” inside the handrails. How high are the handrails? The handrails are 25.5” high. What are the dimensions of the magazine holder? The magazine holder is 8.5” x 7.5” x 2”. Is the magazine holder removable? Yes, the magazine holder can be hung on one of the handrails and is completely removable. Will the stand alone toilet safety rail fit around an elongated toilet bowl? Yes, the safety rail will fit around most toilet bowls including an elongated style. Are tools needed to assemble the stand alone toilet safety rail? No tools are needed to assemble. How many parts does the toilet safety rail come in? The parts list includes: 2x frames with armrests2x U-shaped support bars1x magazine basket8x hand knob screws How do I assemble the stand alone safety rail? The assembly instructions can be found on this video. How do I install the stand alone safety rail? Once fully assembled, place the safety rail up against the toilet so that the handrails are on either side of the toilet. Refer to instructional video above. How much weight will the stand alone toilet safety rail support? The safety rail will support up to 300 pounds. How sturdy is the stand alone toilet safety rail? The safety rail is constructed with safe, durable and strong aluminum that can support up to 300 pounds. Is the stand alone toilet safety rail sturdy enough for long term use? Yes, the aluminum frame is corrosion-resistant making it perfect for long term daily use. Will the stand alone toilet safety rail work around a tub? No, this rail was designed to fit around a toilet or sink, not a tub. Does the bottom rail stick out past the toilet bowl and become a tripping hazard? No, the bottom support rail should tuck right up against the base of the toilet and will not impede your footing. Can the bottom rails be placed behind the toilet bowl? No, the bottom support rails should tuck right up against the front of the toilet. When placed correctly, it should not impede your footing at all. Is there latex in the padded handrails? No, there is no latex in the foam padding. If I put weight on only one side of the stand alone toilet safety rail, will it move or flip? It’s best to use both sides at once for complete security. Is the height of the stand alone toilet safety rail adjustable? No, the height is not adjustable. Will the stand alone toilet safety rail slide on a tile floor? The safety rail is strong and sturdy enough to stay secure on any floor. For added security, your could add weatherstripping to the bottom of the rails. Will the stand alone toilet safety rail work to get up from a couch? No, this rail was designed to fit around a toilet or sink, not to use to get off a couch.
